summary: Billing/subscription system (Convex HTTP API) tested end-to-end. Backend: billing_smoke.py re-run all green; new pytest suite test_billing_extended.py 13/13 passed (PDF /JavaScript rejected, clean PDF accepted, NEEDS_INFO->owner resubmit->PENDING, owner cancel, refund only from APPROVED + note required, plan versions + restore, customer limit + distributor limit enforced, owner/acct/agent get 403 on all 17 /dev/* billing endpoints). Edge script billing_edge_cases.py: assign-plan ok + validation, oversize receipt rejected (4MB), yearly price/days snapshot ok, daily request rate limit enforced, acct/agent cannot cancel/list/submit. Frontend (375x667): owner /upgrade plans list (only published), monthly/yearly segments, choose plan -> upgrade-request-sheet with method option, QR image, copy account, prefilled amount, ref/notes, receipt pick (file chooser) + preview, submit -> request in 'طلبات الدفع' with 'بانتظار التحقق' badge, NEEDS_INFO note + resubmit sheet shown, cancel -> 'ملغى'. Developer: tab-billing -> dev-billing-screen stats/tabs; review-sheet with receipt image, approve/reject/needs-info/under-review buttons; needs-info with note works; Plans: edit price -> 'تعديلات غير منشورة' -> publish -> 'منشورة' (v2); Methods: add method saves; billing-settings-card saves (toast); Orgs: org sheet shows org-subscription-card usage + assign-plan options. Regression: owner password login (single-device prompt -> نعم) -> /owner, all floating tabs navigate. Deprecated API detected: expo-router/unstable-native-tabs.

minor.issue: Refund only flips request status to REFUNDED; org subscription (plan/limits/expires_at) stays active on the refunded plan. Verified: owner current-plan card still shows refunded 'TEST_EXT Pro' as فعّال. Decide: revert org to previous plan/Free or at least warn developer in UI.

Restore filters out null/undefined snapshot fields (`ver.snapshot[k] ?? undefined` then filter), so fields that were null in the old version (e.g. max_distributors:null, promo_price) are NOT cleared on the draft -> restored draft may differ from the selected version. Reference: /app/frontend/convex/billing.ts:173
Editing/restoring an archived plan silently un-archives it (status set to changed/draft). Should reject or keep archived. Reference: billing.ts:118,174
Args validation (e.g. missing price) runs before auth so non-dev tokens get 400 instead of 403 for malformed bodies (not a data leak, just inconsistent).
Returns 404 instead of 403 (acceptable as anti-enumeration, noting only).
Switching to a different plan starts from now and drops remaining paid days of the current plan (no carry-over). Product decision - confirm intended.
